name: Twister Humanoid Robotics Benchmark
description: Benchmarks whole-body humanoid control and LLM reasoning for Twister in MuJoCo.

binding_vow.description: Control a 3D humanoid in MuJoCo to place commanded limbs on colored Twister circles while preserving locked contacts and balance.

observation_space.description: { phase, world_state, command, target_circle, joints, end_effectors, locked_limbs, reachability, ik_suggestion, balance, perf }

action_space.description: { use_ik?, joint_targets?, delta?, max_delta?, follow_ik?, ik_blend?, controller? }

reward.description: Placement reward + stability shaping; failures from falls or constraint violations terminate.

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.description: Pass rate for episodes that successfully place and survive.
